VTS Scoring Log

Peptime

peptime.com · Est. ~2025 · United States · Scored August 2026

Peptime operates an openly browsable catalog. An independent analysis by PeptideBenchmark identified that 5 of 15 reviewed Peptime products link to exact Freedom Diagnostics reports that resolve on the laboratory's own server-controlled report host - meaning the COAs are independently verifiable through Freedom Diagnostics' own system, not just hosted copies on the vendor's site. The five confirmed reports average 99.7% stated purity and include HPLC, identity, and net-content results. Freedom Diagnostics is the same lab used by Verified Peptides (80/100), Ion Peptides (78/100), and Alpha Omega Peptides (64/100) in this catalog. The score is constrained by partial catalog coverage - only one-third of reviewed products had confirmed lab linkages at time of analysis - and a very short operational track record. No operating entity, physical address, or individual names are publicly disclosed on the site.

Community Signal
Independent Lab Verification
PeptideBenchmark independently identified 5 of 15 reviewed Peptime products as linking to exact Freedom Diagnostics reports that resolve on Freedom's own server-controlled host. All five reports resolve (not 404), averaging 99.7% stated purity with HPLC, identity, and net-content results included. This is the primary evidentiary basis for the Freedom Diagnostics score credit. Source: peptidebenchmark.com vendor analysis, August 2026.
Community Experience
Five Trustpilot reviews at time of scoring. Trustpilot profile published under US-based peptide company description. Very limited community discussion in public forums due to the vendor's recent launch. Insufficient review volume to characterize buyer experience patterns.
Scoring Notes
The Freedom Diagnostics linkage is the differentiating signal
Among new vendors with limited track records, having product-linked COAs that resolve on a named lab's own independent servers is a meaningful signal. Most new vendors claim third-party testing without providing verifiable links. The Freedom Diagnostics confirmation on 5 products via PeptideBenchmark analysis places Peptime above email-on-request vendors and unlabeled-COA vendors on the COA Accessibility dimension, despite the partial catalog coverage.
Partial catalog coverage is the primary constraint
PeptideBenchmark confirmed Freedom Diagnostics linkages on 5 of 15 reviewed products. The remaining 10 products have not been independently confirmed with provider-linked documentation. It is possible that additional products have Freedom Diagnostics links not yet captured in the PeptideBenchmark analysis; it is also possible that the confirmed coverage represents the full extent of lab-linked products. VTS scores based on what is independently verifiable at time of scoring. If confirmed lab coverage expands to the full catalog, this score would move into the Moderate band.
Operator anonymity is the unresolved gap
Despite the Freedom Diagnostics lab linkage providing a meaningful verification path, no operating entity, physical address, or individual names are publicly disclosed on the site. A vendor using an independently verifiable lab but disclosing no operator information is a mixed transparency profile - strong on testing evidence, weak on accountability anchors. Operator disclosure would improve the Policy Transparency and Operational Track Record scores without requiring any change to the testing infrastructure.
Sources: peptime.com (catalog, refund-policy/), PeptideBenchmark independent vendor analysis at peptidebenchmark.com (Freedom Diagnostics linkage confirmation on 5 products, August 2026), Trustpilot profile at trustpilot.com/review/peptime.com. VTS measures process transparency from publicly available materials only. It is not a certification of product safety, purity, or efficacy. PeptideClear has no affiliate, referral, or commercial relationship with Peptime. Scored August 2026 - reviewed on a rolling basis as vendor practices change.
